title: FIRST
description: Who's the fastest?

title: SECOND
description: Not THE Fastest, but close enough!

title: THIRD
description: You tried!

title: Daily Check-In
description: Don't forget to check-in!

title: Flashbang
description: Flashbang Nick with a bright screen flash and sound effect!

title: Zoom Camera
description: Zoom right in on Nick's camera for dramatic effect!

title: Force Taunt
description: Force Nick to taunt seekers while hiding.

title: BAZINGA
description: Bazinga! - Sheldon Cooper sound effect on stream.

title: Late to the Game!
description: Nick must wait 10 seconds before moving at the start of the round (If round already started, this will apply next round). Note: this reward will not stack for multiple redemptions.

title: LIGHTS CAMERA ACTION
description:
Set the color of Nick's lights for 60 seconds!

Must choose a listed option: Red, Purple, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Pink, White

title: Q&A
description: Ask your question here! It will be added to a database and Nick will respond once available!

title: SCUBA
description: Scubaaaa Scubaaa sound alert.

title: The Chatter's Touch
description: Specify a color Nick must incorporate into his camouflage artwork.

title: Choose Nick's Skin
description: Pick Nick's character skin for the next match.

title: One-Color Challenge
description: Nick can only use a single color to blend in for the entire round.

title: Ban a Country (International Mode Only)
description: Choose a country that cannot be guessed for the current round.

title: Confidence Lock
description: Once a country/state is said aloud, must choose a spot in that country/state.

title: Silent Raider (Squad Games Only)
description: No comms for 2 minutes unless combat starts.

title: BREAKING NEWS
description: Set a custom Breaking News ticker message at the bottom of the stream for 60 seconds!

title: Pick the Next Drop
description: Choose where Nick lands on the map for the upcoming match.

title: Full Repaint
description: Nick must wipe to pure white and start his camouflage from scratch.

title: Late to Speranza
description: Can't leave the raid until there are only two minutes left.

title: No Vehicles
description: Nick cannot use any vehicle for the next round (including riding with teammates!).

title: Loadout Ban
description: Ban one specific weapon class (e.g. Shotguns, Snipers) for the whole match.

title: No Moving Round
description: Pan/Zoom Allowed, no moving. If in International Mode, must get right country. If US Only, must get right state.

title: GeoGuessr Minigame
description: The torch bearer (member selected from chat) chooses when Nick must stop moving. If his guess is over the maximum distance, the torch passes to another viewer. Repeats until Nick decides to lock-in.

title: One Chest Challenge
description: Nick can only open ONE chest for the entire round. He is still allowed to pickup floor loot.

title: Panic Paint
description: Nick must abandon his current hiding spot and repaint elsewhere!

title: Chat Inventory Management
description: Choose an item that Nick must drop from his backback. Cannot pick it back up, but squad mates can.

title: VIP
description: Become a channel VIP

title: 12 HOUR STREAM*
description: Lock Nick into completing a 12 Hour Stream! (Scheduled and announced on Discord if not current stream).

title: 24 Hour Stream*
description: Lock Nick into completing a 24 Hour Stream! (Scheduled and announced on Discord if not current stream).

title: Airstrike
description: Send in a tactical airstrike on the stream

title: Emote Only Chat
description: Enable emote only chat for 15 seconds!

title: Guide the Raid
description: Type in who you want to raid out to!

title: Mute Nick!
description: Tired of hearing bro yap? Mute him for 15 seconds!

title: MUTE SOMEONE?!
description: Insert the username of the person you want to mute! They will be muted for 60 seconds!

title: END STREAM NOW
description: This will end the stream IMMEDIATELY
